name: Mpox
summary: Clade I mpox spreading outside Africa, including the US and Europe; no WHO emergency in force
state: Clade I mpox continues to be detected outside Africa: ECDC's monthly summary tracks cases in Europe, and San Francisco has detected the strain for the first time (ECDC; Patch). UKHSA lists the countries with clade I transmission. No mpox public health emergency of international concern was in force as of 7 Nov.
for_you: Follow UKHSA and NHS advice on mpox vaccination if you are eligible.
rubric_hit: Clade I spreading outside Africa = Watch; no PHEIC (Alert)
why: Clade I mpox is more severe and has spread beyond Central Africa.
drivers: Case growth, vaccine access, travel-linked spread.

rubric.alert: PHEIC in effect with accelerating growth.
rubric.watch: Clade I spreading outside Africa or a regional surge.
